screens.penny: Hi, {name}! One thing can be a need AND a want. Let's see.

screens.title: The same thing, two ways

cards.caption: Water is a need. Our bodies must have it.
A fizzy drink is a want. Nice, but not needed.

screens.penny: Both are drinks, {name}. Only one is a need.

screens.prompt: You are thirsty. Which one does your body need?
screens.pennyHint: One of these is just water, {name}.
screens.rightMessage: Yes, {name}! Water is the need. A fizzy drink is a treat.
screens.wrongMessage: Good try, {name}! A fizzy drink is nice. Water is what a body needs.

screens.story: Tomas already has a warm coat. In the shop he sees a shiny new one.
screens.prompt: Is the shiny new coat a need or a want?

options.label: A want. He is already warm
options.outcome: Tomas keeps his old coat. He saves the coins for later.

options.label: A need. Coats are always needs
options.outcome: A first warm coat is a need. A second one is a want.

screens.rightMessage: Yes, {name}! One warm coat is a need. A shinier one is a want.
screens.wrongMessage: Good try, {name}! Tomas is already warm. So the new coat is a want.
screens.retryIntro: Let's look at that coat again, {name}.

screens.prompt: One of each pair is the need. Sort them.
screens.pennyHint: Which one does a body really need, {name}?
screens.wrongMessage: Good try, {name}! Is it for school and staying well, or just for fun?
screens.doneMessage: All sorted, {name}! One shop can sell needs and wants together.

screens.prompt: Sana has no shoes for school. Are shoes a need for her?
screens.pennyHint: She walks to school every day, {name}.
screens.rightMessage: Yes, {name}! Shoes keep Sana's feet safe on the way to school.
screens.wrongMessage: Good try, {name}! Sana needs shoes to walk to school safely.
screens.retryIntro: One more look, {name}. Does Sana need shoes?

screens.title: Nice work, {name}!
screens.message: One warm coat is a need. The shiny second one is a want.
